name: Bugfix: main-process planner surfaces lazy-load
description:
Fix the desktop main-process startup crash caused by eager `@invoker/surfaces`
loading in `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts`.

Verified facts from this checkout:
- `packages/app/src/main.ts:249-261` imports `./in-app-planner.js` during
  startup.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:42-43` eagerly imports
  `@invoker/surfaces`, while `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:119-141`
  already contains a later lazy loader.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:342-370` uses the surfaces-backed
  harness-session-driver selector while building the planning conversation
  config, so the eager module import is enough to crash before any planning
  session exists.
- Focused planner restore tests currently pass, so the fix should preserve
  create/restore/submit/tmux behavior while moving only the runtime load
  boundary.

  active planning chat id is not local.
- `packages/app/src/in-app-planner.ts:514-527` silently creates a fresh
  session whenever the incoming `sessionId` is missing or not found.
- focused test runs showed `Turn 1: ... historyMsgs=0`, `Turn 2: ...

Standalone workflow waiver: the user explicitly requested one submitted YAML
handoff file at `plans/invoker-handoff.yaml`. Keep one workflow, but split
the implementation into two behavior slices plus focused proof tasks so each
task still carries one local review claim.

name: Bugfix: truthful planning draft readiness
description:
Make planning chat only advertise or accept `submit` when the current session
has a real current-turn draft.

Root cause from the verified investigation:
- `PlanConversation` can save and show an assistant reply that says `Reply
  \`submit\` to submit it.` even when neither the draft file nor inline YAML
  produced a real draft.
- the in-app terminal command path accepts typed `submit` without first
  checking `draft_ready` / `draftPlanAvailable`.
- backend submit then fails late because `session.draftPlanText` is empty.

Standalone workflow waiver: the user explicitly requested one submitted YAML
handoff file at `plans/invoker-handoff.yaml`. Keep one workflow, but split the
implementation into three sequential behavior tasks so each task still makes
